info.title: Service Topology API
info.summary: Illustrative contract for the future backend. No server implements it yet.
info.description: Draft contract (see docs/API_CONTRACT.md). Each operation lists the frontend repository method it backs in `x-repository`. Payload schemas are the published JSON Schemas in docs/schemas; contract tests validate the mock data and the examples here against them. Authentication, tenancy, rate limits and retention are open decisions and intentionally not specified. Every operation may also return 401/403 (authentication, ADR-018), 429 with Retry-After (rate limit), and 503 (database unavailable) as problem details.

tags.name: transit-boards
tags.description: Authored transit board definitions (ADR-031): the declared structure of a service's board. Observed data is never part of a definition.

tags.name: integrations
tags.description: Topology sources (ADR-034): the Dynatrace connector's status, connection check, sync preview and apply, and aliases. Every operation answers 404 integration-not-configured when the server has no DYNATRACE_CONFIG_FILE.

get.summary: Environments, for the environment selector.
Canonical topology, optionally scoped to one environment.
get.description: Without `environmentId`, returns every environment (what the mock repository returns today). Environment-independent resources (e.g. SaaS APIs) are always included. Referential integrity follows validateTopology.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Project the topology onto one environment: that environment record; all service definitions; instances in it; resources in it (own or inherited) plus environment-independent ones; relationships between kept entities; event types carried in it, with channels narrowed to kept ones. The projection passes the same validation. Unknown environment: 404.

get.summary: Paginated search over instances and communicating resources (registry rows).
get.description: Server-side equivalent of buildRegistryRows + filterRegistryRows + sortRegistryRows. Filters combine with AND across parameters and OR within a list.
get.x-repository: proposed RegistryRepository.search (today computed client-side from getTopology)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: All whitespace-separated terms must match name, ID, owner, or team (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Valid only with the same environmentId, q, filters, and sort (otherwise 400). Offset-based: if the topology changes between pages, rows may shift.

post.description: Writes validate the whole resulting topology with the client's rules (validateTopology) plus the schema's enums and required fields (code `invalid-field`); failures are 422 with `errors[]`. Server-set fields: `updatedAt` is the write time; telemetry (`metrics`) cannot be written (new entities have none, replacements keep the stored values). Requires the editor role when AUTH_MODE=token. The ID must be new across all collections (409 otherwise).

put.description: Writes validate the whole resulting topology with the client's rules (validateTopology) plus the schema's enums and required fields (code `invalid-field`); failures are 422 with `errors[]`. The body's `id` must equal the path ID (IDs cannot change).

delete.description: Refused with 422 while other entities still reference it: `errors[]` lists each blocking reference (validateTopology codes such as `missing-environment`). Requires the editor role when AUTH_MODE=token.

post.summary: Import business flows from a workflow definition
post.description: Decodes a native JSON/YAML flow file or BPMN 2.0 XML into business flows marked imported, validates the whole resulting topology, and writes them. Re-importing an unchanged definition writes nothing (status unchanged). Never overwrites an authored flow (409 import-overwrites-authored). Tasks without a service are rejected by name (422 import-invalid). Needs the editor role when token authentication is on.
post.x-repository: Backend only (ADR-022): workflow definitions are imported through the API or make import-flows; the client reads the result through TopologyRepository.getTopology

post.summary: Replace all data with a data bundle
post.description: Validates a data bundle (docs/DATA_BUNDLE.md, ADR-032): bundle checks (bundle-unsupported, bundle-invalid-module, bundle-duplicate-board), the topology rules, the entity field checks, and each transit board against the bundle's topology. Then replaces the canonical topology and every stored transit board in one transaction. Boards start again at revision 1. Unknown fields are rejected. YAML files are converted to JSON by the client. Needs the editor role when token authentication is on.

200.description: Imported: the new topology revision and what was stored.

get.summary: The Dynatrace connection: tenants, environment rules, and the last sync
get.description: Configuration as shown to users: tenant hosts and how each authenticates (never secrets or file paths), how environments are matched, the refresh interval, the last applied sync, and how many aliases are stored. isExample is true for the fake tenant: its data is example data, never observed.
get.x-repository: IntegrationStore (ADR-034); frontend: Settings → Data source → Dynatrace

post.summary: Run every Dynatrace query once and report what came back
post.description: For diagnosing a connection: per tenant and query, whether it succeeded, the record count, expected fields that no record carries (the field names are taken from public documentation and must be confirmed on a real tenant), missing scopes, scanned bytes, and duration. Never fails as a whole. Needs the editor role when token authentication is on. 409 integration-busy while a preview or check runs.

200.description: One entry per tenant and query.

post.summary: Discover the topology in Dynatrace and preview the changes a sync would make
post.description: Reads Smartscape on Grail, maps it onto canonical entities, and reconciles it with the stored topology (docs/DYNATRACE_CONNECTOR.md §4): entities Dynatrace created are created, updated, or deleted; authored entities with the same ID, the same service and environment, or an alias are linked and never overwritten; entities that disappeared but are still used are kept and flagged. The whole result is validated. The preview is held for 10 minutes; apply it by ID. The ETag is the topology revision it is based on. Needs the editor role when token authentication is on. 502 source-failed when Dynatrace cannot answer; 409 integration-busy while a preview or check runs.

ETag.description: The topology revision the preview is based on; send it as If-Match when applying.

notes.message: 1 call crosses environments and was dropped.

post.description: Applies every change of the preview in one transaction, only if the topology revision is still the one the preview was based on, and records one new revision. A preview applies once. Needs the editor role when token authentication is on.

get.summary: The alias list: Dynatrace service names mapped to service definition IDs
get.description: Aliases are applied before a name's slug when discovering, so a Dynatrace service joins an existing definition (for example PaymentService → payment-service). The ETag is the list's revision.

ETag.description: The alias list revision; send it as If-Match when replacing.

put.description: If-Match is required (the list's ETag; "0" before the first save). At most 1,000 aliases; each target must be a valid entity ID. Needs the editor role when token authentication is on.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null at the end.

errors.description: Validation issues. Topology codes are those of validateTopology; snapshots add invalid-snapshot, layouts invalid-layout; malformed parameters use invalid-parameter.

path.description: The field of a board definition the issue is about (ADR-031).

requestId.description: Extension member: the request ID (also in the X-Request-ID response header), for correlating with server logs.

DependencyEntry.description: One entity at its shortest distance (breadth-first; relationships tried in ID order).

truncated.description: True when more entries exist than `limit`.

ImpactResult.description: Read-only what-if per the propagation rules (simulated reasoning, not a prediction). `flows` (ADR-025, Milestone 12 / B9) maps the result onto business flows, per environment.

flows.description: Business flows with an affected step, per environment (by ID), flows by ID. Additive to contract v1.

FlowImpact.description: One business flow in one environment under a simulated failure (docs/BUSINESS_FLOWS.md §12).

steps.description: Affected steps in the flow's step order.

firstAffectedStepId.description: The first affected step on the typical path; null when the typical path is untouched.

entityId.description: The failing entity behind the step: its service instance, or the channel its input arrives on.

LikelyFlowOutcome.description: `outcome`: where the failure path ends (`outcomeId`), and whether compensation runs. `delayed`: entered by an event with redelivery or a dead-letter queue on a channel that is not unavailable (`transitionId`). `unknown`: no failure path is modelled.

instanceId.description: null when the definition is not deployed in the environment.

relationshipIds.description: Path between instance and channel; empty when not connected.

viaQueueId.description: Queue bound to an exchange channel that the consumer reads from.

durationTicks.description: inject: recover automatically after this many ticks (0 = no scheduled recovery).

ticks.description: step: ticks to advance (10 simulated seconds each).

SimulationRequest.description: An isolated, deterministic run of the simulation engine on a read-only copy of the canonical topology (ADR-016). Bounds: ≤ 100 actions, ≤ 500 ticks in total, ≤ 5 watched entities.

watch.description: Entities whose simulated metrics are recorded as telemetry at every tick.

captureSnapshot.description: Store the final state as a snapshot with source "simulation" (ID = run ID).

clock.description: Simulated clock at the end of the run, not wall-clock time.

sourceType.description: Where the stored topology came from, e.g. "fixture". Only "observed" data is not mock.

WritableEntityKind.description: Entity kinds accepted by the write operations (ADR-020): the selection kinds plus event-type and business-flow (ADR-022). Imported business flows are read-only (409 imported-read-only).

FlowImport.description: Import workflow definitions as business flows (ADR-022, docs/BUSINESS_FLOWS.md §4).

format.description: native: a BusinessFlow (or {"flows": [...]}) as JSON or YAML; bpmn: BPMN 2.0 XML.

ref.description: Source shown on imported flows (file name, repository URL).

events.description: Sequence/message flow ID, or message:<messageRef> → event type ID.

entryPoints.description: Task ID → operation that implements it.

revision.description: The new topology revision (also the ETag).

documents.description: Entities stored per topology module, keyed like the bundle.

isExample.description: True when a tenant is an example (fake) tenant: its data is mock, never observed.

match.description: The rule in words, e.g. "tag environment = production".

summary.description: Changes per entity kind and operation.

missingFields.description: Expected fields that no record carries.

message.description: Dynatrace's (shortened) explanation of a failure, or a limit note. Never credentials.

op.description: create: new, owned by Dynatrace; update: owned, changed in Dynatrace; link: authored, linked (nothing overwritten); keep: owned, gone from Dynatrace but still used (health unknown, relationships inactive); delete: owned and gone.

usedBy.description: For keep: the entities, flows, or boards (transit-board:<service>) that use it.

summary.description: Changes per entity kind and operation.

issues.description: Validation of the resulting topology; any error makes canApply false.

summary.description: Changes per entity kind and operation.

bearerAuth.description: Required on /api/v1 when the server runs with AUTH_MODE=token (ADR-018): reader tokens may call GET operations, editor tokens all operations. Missing/invalid token: 401; read-only token on a write: 403. With AUTH_MODE=none the API must only listen on loopback or behind an authenticating proxy.

ETag.description: Topology revision as a strong entity tag. Send it back in If-Match on writes.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Topology revision (ETag of GET /topology or of the previous write). When present and no longer current, the write is refused with 412 so concurrent edits are not lost. Omit to write unconditionally.
